'''Story Mode''' is the main mode of the game, with each World being different iconic Anime locations. They reward the Player items and Gems, and your Units receive XP to level up. For every level completed for the first time, you receive an extra 5 Gems (unconfirmed) in addition to the completion reward.

<tabber>
|-|Planet Namak=
== Planet Namak ==
Planet Namak from Dragon Ball Z, is the first World of Story Mode, with maps consisting of a decently long path, with few areas designated for hill units. Each mission you complete grants you XP Food for your units and Gems.

|-|Shiganshina District=
== Shinganshina District  ==
Shiganshina District from Attack on Titan, is the second Story Mode map. Each mission you complete grants you XP Food for your units and Gems.

|-|Snowy Town=
== Snowy Town ==
Snowy Town from Demon Slayer, is the third Story Mode map. Each mission you complete grants you XP Food for your units and Gems.

|-|Hidden Sand Village=
== Hidden Sand Village ==
Hidden Sand Village from Naruto, is the fourth Story Mode map. Each mission you complete grants you XP Food for your units and Gems.
